principles: Administrator navigation is role-specific, not a progressively hidden copy of the platform-super-admin menu.
Every visible working item is a direct route to the requested screen; category labels may group items but do not add an extra click.
Menu projection never widens authorization. Capability checks remain authoritative.
Platform control-plane capabilities never leak into delegated or local operator navigation.

groups.purpose: 플랫폼 전체 현황, 알림, 우선 조치
사이트 분류(왼쪽) → 분류의 사이트 버튼(위) → 선택한 사이트의 관리자 메뉴(아래, 각 /{site}/admin 으로 연결)
자동점검, 배포·장애, 시스템 구조, 실행 인프라 (전체 운영상태는 홈 › 플랫폼 현황으로 통합)
공통 UI·디자인, 언어, 외부 연동·API, 저장소

platform-super-admin.leftDetailRule: ADMIN-LAYOUT-3L-001: the left sidebar shows the eight control areas (1차) and the active area's menus (2차) only. The active menu's detail routes (3차) render as a button strip at the top of the workspace and the selected detail's settings render below it. A menu with one detail route shows no strip.
platform-super-admin.serviceGroupRule: Services & Engines renders the engine catalog as 3차 detail buttons of one menu in the workspace strip; the retired context tab shell stays retired.
platform-super-admin.legacyDeepLinks: Previously canonical routes remain accepted as aliases after navigation reclassification.
platform-super-admin.siteOperationsRule: Per-site operations (channels, events, members, messages) live only in each site admin (/{site}/admin); the platform admin lists sites and hands off. Platform-global engines (EKODI Books, devotional autopost, channel control center, EKODI Work) are platform services under ADMIN-AUDIENCE-001.
platform-super-admin.siteManagementRule: 사이트관리 2차 menus are site classifications; the strip lists that classification's sites; the selected site's own admin menus render below as hand-off links to its canonical /{site}/admin/{menu}. No child-admin alias is created under /admin.
platform-super-admin.riskGuardRule: ADMIN-RISK-GUARD-001: high-risk settings (registry risk:high) require an explicit confirmation before save, are recorded in change history, and offer one-step undo when the previous state is known.
